analyst.note: One configured frontier analyst for every synthesis edition. MARKET_BRIEF_MODEL overrides the OpenRouter model ID (and disables the fallback); fallback_model is attempted once, only when OpenRouter reports the primary has no available endpoint. The resolved identity, route, whether fallback occurred, and usage are recorded per run.

PREMARKET.guidance: The day's one rich read: prior close, overnight and premarket evidence, cross-asset context, today's events, and the open questions carried from the previous close.

OPEN_30M.guidance: The one interpretive update after the open, with the full evidence record. In order: what the open did to the premarket read; the strongest and weakest sectors and whether the move is broad or concentrated; the release or report that explains it by ID, or say plainly that none in these sources does; one supported read and its strongest rival; rates only with their date (the official curve is the previous business day's). Concise: about 60 words of summary. No later edition reinterprets the session.

cadence_note: Only synthesis checkpoints carry an edition profile: PREMARKET (NYSE open minus thirty minutes) and OPEN_30M (open plus thirty minutes). OPEN_1M (open plus one minute), the hourly refreshes (exchange-clock hours inside the session) and CLOSE_1M (close plus one minute) are deterministic: they refresh observed rows under the last accepted interpretation and never call the analyst (see schedule.CHECKPOINT_KINDS).
